SELECT r.id AS role_id, r.code AS role_code, r.display_name AS role_display_name, m.id AS menu_id, m.code AS menu_code, m.name AS menu_name, m.display_name AS menu_display_name, m.icon AS menu_icon, m.path AS menu_path, m.component AS menu_component, m.permission_name AS menu_permission_name, m.sort_order AS menu_sort_order FROM whale_roles r INNER JOIN whale_user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN whale_permission_grants pg ON r.id = pg.provider_key AND pg.provider_name = 'R' INNER JOIN whale_menus m ON pg.permission_name = m.permission_name WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND pg.is_deleted = 0 AND m.is_enabled = 1 AND m.is_hidden = 0 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND (m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR m.tenant_id IS NULL) AND m.menu_type = 'menu'
AND m.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY r.code, m.sort_order
